name: Capability
insp: corporate data rooms, investor dashboards and product analytics sites
desc: A dark, precise data room for companies, trusts and employers. The 4K brand cubes drift with your cursor behind a live At a glance panel; the tax year then pins and draws itself, with the real IRD dates and today marked.
fx: Tax year chart pins and draws itself as you scroll, with the real IRD dates and today marked
Next IRD date worked out live from today
Brand cubes drift with your cursor behind a glass panel
Headline lines rise out of a mask
Service tables fold open slowly while a green rule follows your row
Checklist ticks draw themselves and are remembered on your device
